# x402 Hash Generator

> Fast, deterministic cryptographic hashing for agents. SHA-256 (default), SHA-1, MD5, SHA-512. Perfect for content addressing, cache keys, and integrity checks. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/hash
  - Input: `{ "text": "..." | object, "algorithm": "sha256|sha1|md5|sha512" }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "hash": "hex...", "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.006 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Pure crypto, zero side effects
- Content-addressable storage keys
- Cheap enough for high-frequency use
